texts.app.name: Ask 2 Learn
texts.cli.watch: Watching for 30 s. Switch to a game or go idle to test.
texts.cli.all_ok: All texts translated: interface in {ui}, courses in their native languages.
texts.ob.tagline: The language app that keeps asking until you've got it.
texts.ob.no_course: There's no course for this native language yet.
texts.ob.toast_body: From now on I'll quiz you on {lang}. {how} Good luck.
texts.ov.title: Overview
texts.ov.next_vocab: {n} words in three rounds: recognise, match, write.
texts.ov.next_grammar: A short explanation, then {n} exercises: first choose, then write.
texts.ov.course_done_sub: Repeat lessons and play the {@name.daily} to make it all stick.
texts.ov.daily_locked_sub: Unlocks as soon as you've answered your first words correctly.
texts.ov.daily_done_sub: You can play again or reshuffle.
texts.ov.daily_waiting_sub: No second chances – how many do you still know?
texts.course.title: Course {level}
texts.course.sub: {variant}. {done} of {total} lessons completed. Basic vocabulary first, then grammar, then more words and more grammar. You can repeat every lesson as often as you like.
texts.section.title: Section {n} of {t}
texts.section.hint: You can practise each section on its own. Once all are done, the lesson counts as done.
texts.lesson.status: Best score {p} % · done {r}×. You can repeat the lesson any time.
texts.round.label: Round {n} of {t} · {name}
texts.tip.title: Tip
texts.grammar.intro: Read the explanation, then off you go: first {a} exercises where you choose, then {b} where you write.
texts.cards.title: {title} · Flashcards
texts.cards.sub: Read the word, think about what it means, then flip the card.
texts.cards.hint: Click or press space to flip
texts.sum.good: Well done. Your mistakes will come back in review soon.
texts.sum.low: Keep at it – feel free to repeat the lesson. It gets easier every time.
texts.sum.sub: {title}: {r} of {n} right on the first try.
texts.sum.mistakes: YOU GOT THESE WRONG ON THE FIRST TRY
texts.daily.title: {@name.daily}
texts.daily.sub: Every day, {n} words you've answered correctly before – a mix of choosing and writing, in both directions, no second chances.
texts.daily.none_sub: Do a few vocabulary lessons first. Every word you've answered correctly once can show up here.
texts.daily.few: You know {k} words so far – that's why there are {n} today. Every lesson adds more.
texts.daily.redrawn: Reshuffled: {n} different words are in now.
texts.daily.redrawn_few: Reshuffled. You don't know enough words yet for a completely new set – keep learning!
texts.daily.how1: Every day you automatically get {n} new random words from everything you already know.
texts.daily.how2: Each word comes up exactly once – like a little test.
texts.daily.how3: “Reshuffle” swaps the selection for {n} different words.
texts.daily.how4: Mistakes count for your reviews too: words you get wrong come back soon.
texts.rev.title: Review
texts.rev.sub: Words you've learned come back at growing intervals: after 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16 days. Get one wrong and it starts over.
texts.rev.due_many: The {n} longest-overdue words come up now.
texts.rev.due_all: Right now is the best moment to review them.
texts.rev.none_sub: Once you've practised words in a lesson, they'll show up here again.
texts.rev.hard_sub: The words you got wrong most often: {list}
texts.rev.mix_sub: {n} random words from everything you've seen.
texts.words.title: Dictionary
texts.words.sub: All {n} words in the course and how well you know them.
texts.set.title: Settings
texts.set.sub: Language, annoyance level and how often {@app.short} quizzes you.
texts.set.native_sub: The course shows translations, tips and grammar explanations in this language.
texts.set.app_lang_sub: The language of menus, buttons, messages and lesson titles. Translations and explanations in the lessons follow your native language.
texts.set.app_lang_detected: Detected automatically from your system language.
texts.set.lang_note: Your progress is saved separately for each language.
texts.set.annoy_sub: How much should I bug you? While you're in fullscreen (games, videos) I wait, except at “{@set.annoy.fuckoff}”.
texts.set.annoy.never_d: No quizzes. You only learn when you open the window.
texts.set.annoy.once_d: One quiz each time the app starts.
texts.set.annoy.random_d: Some time between 1 and 20 hours later. You never know when.
texts.set.annoy.possible_d: Every 15 minutes. Ignored? It's back in 2 minutes.
texts.set.annoy.possible_info: You get a question whenever possible, but not interrupting what you are doing.
texts.set.annoy.fuckoff_warn: {@set.annoy.fuckoff} will pull you out of everything so you can answer.
texts.set.annoy.fuckoff_d: Every 5 minutes. Ignored? Back in 1 minute, with a looping sound from the second time. Even pulls you out of fullscreen.
texts.set.nag: Minutes until an ignored quiz comes back
texts.set.wrong: Minutes until a wrongly answered word comes back
texts.set.reset_sub: Deletes all word levels, completed lessons and statistics for {lang}. This can't be undone.
texts.set.reset_q: Really delete all progress, lessons and statistics for {lang}?
texts.alert.title: Pause. One question first.
texts.alert.sub: You picked “{@set.annoy.fuckoff}”, so I pull you out of fullscreen too. Answer and you can carry on.
texts.notif.ignored1: Ignored. No problem, I've got time. 🙂
texts.notif.retry: Coming back in {n} min. Until you get it.
texts.tray.pause: Leave me alone for 1 hour (if you must)
texts.setup.intro2: quiz you with notifications, once an hour to start with (you choose how often in the settings)
texts.setup.intro3: bring a quiz back if you ignore it
texts.setup.intro4: not stop until you know your words
texts.setup.question: Do you really want to be asked until you know your words? (y/n)
texts.setup.removed_done: Peace and quiet restored. Your progress is still in {folder}.
texts.setup.done: {@app.name} is open. You asked for this. :)
texts.setup.no_venv: No .venv found. Run setup.bat once first.
